name: overview-dashboard
title: Overview dashboard
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Composes KPI cards, a trend chart, an upcoming list, and content counts into one overview.

files.content:
"use client" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card" import { StatCard, TrendChart, type TrendPoint } from "@/components/ui/admin-charts" import type { ChartTone } from "@/lib/chart-tone" export type OverviewStat = { id: string label: string value: number previous?: number sparkline?: readonly number[] tone?: ChartTone caption?: string } export type OverviewCount = { label: string value: number href?: string } export type OverviewUpcoming = { id: string title: string meta: string } export type OverviewDashboardProps = { stats: readonly OverviewStat[] trend: readonly TrendPoint[] upcoming: readonly OverviewUpcoming[] counts: readonly OverviewCount[] onOpen?: (href: string) => void title?: string trendTitle?: string upcomingTitle?: string countsTitle?: string emptyUpcoming?: string visitorsLabel?: string viewsLabel?: string className?: string } export function OverviewDashboard({ stats, trend, upcoming, counts, onOpen, title = "Overview", trendTitle = "This week", upcomingTitle = "Next calls", countsTitle = "On the site", emptyUpcoming = "Nothing scheduled.", visitorsLabel = "Visitors", viewsLabel = "Page views", className, }: OverviewDashboardProps) { return (

{title}

{stats.map((stat) => ( ))}
{upcomingTitle} {upcoming.length === 0 ? (

{emptyUpcoming}

) : ( upcoming.map((item) => (
{item.title} {item.meta}
)) )}
{countsTitle}
    {counts.map((item) => (
  • {item.href && onOpen ? ( ) : (
    {item.label} {item.value}
    )}
    • ))}
) }

meta.descriptionEs: Compone tarjetas, la tendencia, las próximas llamadas y los conteos del sitio.

examples.title: Resumen
examples.description: Datos ficticios. Los conteos avisan con un toast.

api.name: stats
api.description: Passed through to StatCard, including tone and sparkline.

api.name: upcoming / counts
api.description: Calls and site totals. counts may include an href for onOpen.

api.name: trendTitle
api.description: Heading on the trend chart. Default This week.

api.name: visitorsLabel / viewsLabel
api.description: Series names forwarded to TrendChart. Defaults Visitors and Page views.

api.name: emptyUpcoming
api.description: Copy when the upcoming list is empty. Default Nothing scheduled.

docs: Presentational. The admin-kit block is what fills it from the in-memory adapter.
